# Ali Iqrash

> Ali Iqrash is a System Engineer in Group Network Technology (GNT) at Deutsche Telekom in Bonn, Germany. He integrates and certifies 5G devices, validates new network features, and automates device and protocol testing.

## Current role

**System Engineer — Deutsche Telekom, Bonn (January 2026 – present).**
Group Network Technology (GNT), Device Testing & Certification. Moved internally from the ORBIT consultant role in the same team.

- Integrates and validates new network features on recent releases, including Network Slicing and UL/DL Carrier Aggregation.
- Writes 5G SA test cases and scenarios for handset and chipset certification against Deutsche Telekom standards.
- Sets up test environments with network simulators, mobile phone testers and OTA chambers.
- Performs protocol testing in LTE, 5G NSA/SA and O-RAN, including 3GPP VoWiFi, ePDG and IMS signalling.
- Analyses logs with Accuver XCAL, QXDM, Shannon DM, Rohde & Schwarz CMW/CMX500 and Wireshark.

## Experience

**Network Protocol Test Engineer — ORBIT, Bonn (November 2023 – December 2025).**
Consultant for Deutsche Telekom, Device Testing & Certification. Protocol testing of LTE / 5G NSA and SA / O-RAN devices, 5G SA test case design, OTA chambers, VoWiFi/ePDG/IMS, tracing tools.

**Working Student, Telco Solutions — MicroNova AG, Munich (February 2023 – October 2023).**
5G Network Slicing proof of concept for Telefónica; slicing service catalogue per 3GPP; RAN and core integration.

**RAN Integration Engineer — Huawei Technologies, Pakistan (October 2019 – November 2021).**
Mobily (KSA) project. Integrated 5G, LTE carrier addition, Multi-RAN to SingleRAN, and MIMO 4T4R/32T32R/64T64R. Led 5 engineers and delivered 1,200 NB-IoT expansion sites in 3 months.

## Skills

- **Feature integration:** Network Slicing, UL/DL Carrier Aggregation, VoWiFi, ePDG, IMS, 3GPP and Deutsche Telekom standards, CA combinations.
- **Device testing and certification:** 5G SA/NSA handsets and chipsets, test case design, protocol testing, OTA chambers, network simulators, LTE, O-RAN.
- **Tools and tracing:** Accuver XCAL, QXDM, Shannon DM, Rohde & Schwarz CMW/CMX500, Wireshark, GitLab/GitHub.
- **Automation and data:** Python, pytest, Robot Framework, POSTMAN, SOAP UI, NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, MATLAB/Simulink, AI agents.

## Projects

- **SON function of MRO as an xApp on the O-RAN RIC** (TU Ilmenau, Oct 2022 – Feb 2023): ONOS RIC, RAN simulator, adapted SON MRO/MLB as an xApp via RIC APIs, designed and measured SON for URLLC.
- **Real-time load estimation of an LTE cell** (KNRTU, Nov 2021 – Jul 2022): decoded DCI on PDCCH to count unique RNTIs, prototype on SDRs, tested on 5+ commercial sites with up to 90% user-detection efficiency.
- **API testing with SOAP UI** (Nov 2024 – Jan 2025): SOAP API testing with mock servers, evolved into an automation mini-app.
- **Enhancing security via speaker recognition** (University of Sargodha, 2017 – 2018): MATLAB MFCC extraction and vector quantisation for voice matching.
